entries.1c2cc3eb25f6c5e0: This business is not included in reportable segments and groups together semiconductor test products, microswitches and jigs and tools for connectors. Semiconductor test products are manufactured and sold by S.E.R. Co., Ltd. (now Hirose SER Co., Ltd.), which became a consolidated subsidiary in July 2025. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥7,112 million.

entries.77e0cb6f93d5a0d0: This business manufactures and sells specialized high-performance connectors that connect high-frequency signals such as microwaves, and also includes optical connectors and coaxial switches.
entries.93b17fa6dc03bea6: This business manufactures and sells specialized high-performance connectors that connect high-frequency signals such as microwaves, and also includes optical connectors and coaxial switches. They are used for antenna connections for wireless LAN and Bluetooth communication in smartphones and PCs, GPS antenna connections in automobiles, and high-frequency signal connections in wireless communication equipment and electronic measuring instruments, among others. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥18,338 million.
entries.d8c4ec11c53382c6: A specialist connector manufacturer that makes and sells electronic components, centered on multi-pin connectors and coaxial connectors, and also handles semiconductor test products and more.
entries.f4174ad6fafeedcc: This is the core business of the Group, manufacturing and selling round and rectangular connectors mounted on the outside of equipment, and ribbon cable connectors, printed circuit board connectors, FPC (flexible printed circuit) connectors and nylon connectors mounted inside equipment. They are widely used, from smartphones, communication equipment and car electronics to industrial equipment such as measurement and control instruments, FA equipment and medical devices. In Japan, Tohoku Hirose Denki, Koriyama Hirose Denki and Ichinoseki Hirose Denki handle manufacturing, and overseas, subsidiaries in South Korea, China, Taiwan, Malaysia and Indonesia handle manufacturing. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥185,814 million, accounting for most of consolidated revenue.
